goal: Tighten map circle spacing; keep empty bubbles 30 days instead of 24h
summary: Bubbles on the map were far apart because labelRoom reserved label room for every group, and labels are a fixed screen size: zoomed out, each label covers ~2000 world units, so the fit loop spiralled down to MIN_ZOOM with bubbles ~126px apart on screen (radius ~20px) for the 25-group seed world. labelRoom now skips groups whose bubble is <= LABEL_MIN_R (24px) on screen at that zoom (those labels were never drawn anyway). Since bubbles now sit tighter, labels are drawn after all bubbles with a greedy declutter: hovered first, then biggest bubbles; a label that would overlap another bubble or an already-drawn label is skipped (the hovered one always shows). Simulated gap for 25 groups: 126px -> 23px; 12 groups: 108px -> 26px; 6 groups unchanged (their labels are drawn and set the spacing). Second change: empty bubbles now linger 30 days after the last person leaves (was 24h). lib/time.ts splits lingerMs into groupLingerMs (30d) and awayMs (30 days, per the human: people who left stay 'away' in the bubble 30 days too); Store.getGraph takes a Linger {groupMs, awayMs}, expireGroups takes groupLingerMs. UI copy (RoomHeader, NewGroupDialog, map subtitle), README, .env.example and project.json updated. lib/types.ts comment updated. FAST_CLOCK=1 still shrinks both to 2 minutes.

decisions.what: Hide colliding labels at draw time instead of reserving room for every label
decisions.why: Reserving room for labels that may only appear at mid zoom is what spread the bubbles; decluttering keeps names off other bubbles without that cost

decisions.what: Bubbles and the 'away' window are both 30 days, kept as two functions (groupLingerMs, awayMs)
decisions.why: The human asked for both to be 30 days; separate names keep them independently tunable
